text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Urara... Please think this through again.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, it'll be fine! I don't know
them, but
I'm sure they're a good
person!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Prez wants me to meet someone I've
never
met before!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I know the student council is involved,
but you
still ought to know what you're
getting into to be
prepared.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Okay! Then you come too, Ayabe! Hurry!
choice_data_list: 確かに心配だ、俺がウララについていくよ
確かに心配だね、私がウララについていくよ
choice_data_list_en: That's definitely a worry. I'll go with Urara.
That's definitely a worry. I'll go with Urara.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Hey, wait, why am I—

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
And so, Urara, I want you gorgeously
adorning
the posters I'm making to
advertise my inn!

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
I saw you on TV, during the Umamusume
karuta
tournament! The confidence and
grace you
showed is perfect for
representing this
establishment!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yippee! I'll do my best, of course!

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! Now that you're on
board, I'd
also really like to include that
girl who suddenly
joined partway into
the tournament!

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The Umamusume who showed up in
the latter
half of the karuta competition.
She had this
dignified prowess about
her.

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
If I had to describe her, I'd say she was
just like...
this fine lady... here...

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text: I-it's you! What a miraculous coincidence! Please, you have to join the photo shoot for the posters!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, but no.

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text: Gasp! ...Is, is that so? I understand...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat? But why? You should definitely
join in,
Ayabe! It's gonna be so much
fun!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Sigh... There are plenty of other people more suited to this than I am.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Like someone positive who makes you
happy just
looking at her. You'd attract
way more customers
by employing
someone like that. Right?

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text: That's...

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text: That's wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
You really thought deeply into what
would be
profitable for my business!
How considerate of
you!

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
During the tournament, what kept me on
the
edge of my seat was precisely that
contemplative
expression of yours, so
focused on the match!
Your cooperation
is just the catalyst the inn
needs for
business to boom!

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
So please, won't you reconsider? I beg
of you!

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I'll see to it that there are no

repercussions to you, your races, or
anything else!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Even still... I...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Not you too... Geez...
choice_data_list: もう1度考えてみてあげたら？
完成したポスターを見るのが楽しみ！
choice_data_list_en: Why not give it another thought for their sake?
I can't wait to see the finished poster!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So you're coming along?! Yay, a photo
shoot with
Ayabe! ♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
What do you wanna do at the inn? Hmm,
I
wonder what they have.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I know! Hot springs! They have one,
right?! Let's
get in together! Hot springs,
hot springs! ♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Urara, you do know we aren't going
there for
fun, right?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Don't you want to soak in the hot
springs?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I do—wait... Whether I want to or not is
besides
the point.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! Of course you wanna enjoy the
hot
springs! ♪ Let's dive in with a splash!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Urara... For the last time...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Sigh.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Admire Vega agrees to model
for the
posters.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! I'll be there with you, so
you'll do
just fine!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...It's not like I don't want to do it. That's
not the
point...

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
Then, please! That indescribable aura of

yours—no, that bold charm like no
other—I must
capture it in my posters!

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
I'm confident that you symbolize the
inn's
motto—"Hospitality with Sincerity"!
Not to
mention the plethora of other
reasons why I'm
asking you!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I get it, I get it. You don't have to keep asking.

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text: D-does that mean—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'll do it. Though I don't think I'll
measure up to
your expectations...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Don't act like I already said yes. You can
stop it
with the flattery, too.

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
It's true! The charisma you're presenting
in this
very moment would inspire
thousands if captured
in my posters!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Like I said...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ooh ooh! I know lots of places where
Ayabe looks
cool! Like, the other day,
while we were out
running...

text_block_list.name: Inn Owner
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I see! It's guaranteed my posters
will turn out
fantastic!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...All right, fine! I get it, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
If you're going to be this annoying, it'll
be less of
a hassle if I just do it.
